scope: Independent public consulting/SI and specialist Pega professional research, Bengaluru first, with role-specific remote checks. Bounded follow-up outside the portal.

method.access: Public web search index and public LinkedIn pages only; no login or access bypass.
method.attribution: Only profile About, named employer/experience, certifications, attributed own posts and explicitly attributed recommendations were used for people. Likes, reposts and same-name suggestions were not silently converted into personal experience.
method.vacancies: People are not vacancies; employee movement never establishes a backfill. Employer-labelled LinkedIn postings are distinguished from a verified employer career-site application.
method.dates: checked_at is this research date. Unknown publication dates remain null; relative display labels are preserved separately. Crawl age is not source publication date.
method.privacy: Professional identity, role, employer, work topics and public profile URLs only. No personal contact details, credential IDs or sensitive traits collected.
method.novelty: Existing independent-map names were read only to identify additions; old claims were not evidence for these records.

queries.outcome: No defensible Rulesware employment/location match in the returned index; activity and same-name suggestions were excluded.
Direct Bits In Glass profile candidates found; some apparent Bangalore or hiring matches belonged to liked posts and were excluded.
A Quavo employee profile with Pega experience was found in Texas; India-remote or current Bengaluru eligibility not established.
Three HashedIn by Deloitte profiles with Pega self-descriptions found; two show Bengaluru consistently and one has a Hyderabad role-location conflict.
Evoke profile evidence found; one apparently relevant profile has conflicting Mphasis/Evoke employer text and is kept under a conflict flag.
Hexaware Bengaluru profile with Pega credentials found; liked certifications or third-party POCs on other profiles were excluded.
Bits In Glass company jobs index and further direct profiles found. The company page index is stale/inconsistent with its opened card list.
No defensible Exavalu employment match obtained from the pooled result set; no negative claim about its Pega practice is made.
No India-remote Rulesware vacancy established. Returned Bits In Glass remote language applies only to unspecified select roles.
No reliable current HashedIn Pega job established. Pooled results surfaced additional consulting vacancies and a historical non-Pega HashedIn post.
No usable official Bits In Glass career page returned in this bounded query batch; public LinkedIn profile/job evidence retained separately.
No usable official Evoke practice/career page returned in this bounded query batch; no employer-page claim added.

checks.outcome: Readable public listing; three role families and mandatory hands-on Constellation verified. No salary or universal remote policy disclosed.
Readable exact page explicitly states No longer accepting applications; supersedes the open-looking search index.
Readable company jobs page shows non-Pega cards, unlike the indexed Pega LSA/Decisioning cards. Old cards remain unverified.
